sqls.title: Create index
sqls.description: SQL to safely and idempotently (re)create NONCLUSTERED indexes. The check itself can be improved to use only OBJECT_ID, however I'm a litte paranoid and I like to check name also.

sqls.title: Dynamic drop of indexes
sqls.description: Script to perform `hard reset` of the set of the tables. It removes all the indexes from the table. Be wary that active FOREIGN KEY constraints may influence the execution of this script.

sqls.title: Buffer Clean
sqls.description: The most important script during the process of hammering bugs. Use it to clear the state of SQL SERVER memory and force it to generate new executions plans (due to the cleanup of the procedure cache) for Stored Procedures and perform the physical IO (due to cleanup of the buffers)
sqls.sql:
DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS
GO

DBCC FREEPROCCACHE
GO

sqls.title: Safe delete
sqls.description: Safely deletes the content of the table - without thrashing the system log

sqls.title: Clustered Index recreate
sqls.description: Recreates the clustered index of the table. Be wary that active FOREIGN KEY constraints may influence the execution of this script.
